environment.description: Node.js 18 Express application deployed on an EC2 instance behind an Application Load Balancer. The service runs as root user in a Docker container with the host filesystem mounted at /mnt/host for log aggregation. The ALB forwards all traffic on port 443 to the target group. No request filtering or authentication middleware is configured. Security groups allow inbound HTTPS from 0.0.0.0/0.

config.network: ALB with public-facing listener, no WAF
config.filesystem: Read-write access to host filesystem via mount
